title: Implement JPEG and authoritative time validation

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: JPEG validation tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/inventory/test_jpeg_validation.py

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-admission.md#jpeg-and-time-contract RED: no inventory-owned validator produces a bounded decoded JPEG candidate with authoritative date/time metadata; GREEN: deterministic fixtures accept valid JPEGs, reject media/bounds/decode/orientation failures, hash exact bytes and derive EXIF, upload-start or 01:00 fallback captured_at without changing visit_date; decisive comparison: every fixture matches the canonical result and warning; artifact: unit test output and fixture manifest.
purpose: Turn one uploaded byte stream into a deterministic validated Photo candidate while preserving the photographer-selected date.
success_outcome: Inventory produces a validated JPEG candidate with exact SHA-256, dimensions, byte size, effective captured_at/source and optional EXIF-date warning, or a decisive rejection with no persistence.
anti_goals: Do not stage objects, persist Photos, emit HTTP responses or normalize/rewrite original JPEG bytes.
Do not add RAW support, EXIF auto-grouping, image enhancement or processing-pipeline behavior.

forbidden_scope: RAW or non-JPEG ingest and downstream face processing
stop_conditions: A validation choice would change accepted product behavior or configured limit ownership.
The implementation would rewrite original bytes or silently replace visit_date.
A new ingest format or grouping lifecycle becomes necessary.

constraints: Deployment supplies positive compressed-byte, decoded-side and decoded-pixel limits; deterministic tests bind explicit values.
SHA-256 covers the exact uploaded byte stream before decode normalization.
Reliable EXIF is interpreted with its valid offset or the configured СПА IANA timezone.
invariants: visit_date remains authoritative and an EXIF date mismatch only produces the allowed warning.
Fallback order is reliable EXIF, upload-start instant, then 01:00 in the СПА timezone.
Invalid or undecodable input produces no persistence side effect.
verification_targets: Deterministic fixtures cover valid, media-type, byte, decoded-size, pixel, decode, EXIF-orientation, timezone, mismatch and fallback cases.
